usage: Antlered reindeer stand beside an open timber shelter.

usage: Cookie walls and piped icing frame a warm bakery window.
growth: Candy details, extra ovens and a giant rooftop sweet mark each expansion.

usage: Giant striped candy canes rise from a copper sugar kettle.
growth: Taller crooks and additional kettles turn a single boiler into a candy skyline.

usage: Open-front timber stalls sell gifts beneath striped awnings.
growth: More stalls, goods and festoon lights fill the market square.

usage: A walk-in mailbox sorts letters beside a striped North Pole marker.
growth: The mail hatch expands into a sorting office with sacks and a taller pole.

usage: Tiny skaters circle an ice-blue rink edged with lanterns.
growth: The ice grows wider as skaters, benches and spectator stands arrive.

usage: A wooden nutcracker stands to attention with a hinged jaw and gold buttons.
growth: Taller boots, a broader uniform and ceremonial regalia rise over the square.

name: Carolers’ Bandstand
description: Robed singers hold open songbooks beneath a musical crest.
usage: Robed singers hold open songbooks beneath a musical crest.
growth: A handful of singers grows into a choir on tiered risers.

description: Meet Black Santa in his red coat and white beard on an open-front Christmas throne.
usage: Meet Black Santa in his red coat and white beard on an open-front Christmas throne.
growth: A little chair becomes an illuminated audience pavilion surrounded by gifts.

usage: A building-sized parcel wears a sculpted ribbon bow.
growth: The lid and bow grow taller as smaller wrapped gifts gather by the door.

name: Nativity Stable
description: A star hangs above an open manger, Mary and Joseph.
usage: A star hangs above an open manger, Mary and Joseph.
growth: Shepherds, travelers and gifts join the scene beneath a taller star.

usage: A gilded base holds an open ice-crystal dome around a tiny winter scene.
growth: Wider domes frame larger miniatures and a growing constellation of snow.

name: Reindeer Carousel
description: Painted reindeer turn on brass poles below a striped canopy.
usage: Painted reindeer turn on brass poles below a striped canopy.
growth: More mounts and taller decorated canopies crown the expanding ride.

name: Christmas Bell Tower
description: Flared brass bells hang in an open timber belfry.
usage: Flared brass bells hang in an open timber belfry.
growth: New hanging bells, lofts and a rising crown turn the single chime into a carillon.

name: Borough Assembly
description: Residents take the floor in an open council chamber with rising timber benches.
usage: Place the public grounds against the institution to carry a promenade across the boundary.
growth: The dais gains public seating, committee rooms and illuminated galleries around the council floor.

name: Civic Records Archive
description: Deep bronze-edged record stacks preserve the city’s deeds, charters and maps.
usage: Place the public grounds against the institution to carry a promenade across the boundary.
growth: New stacks rise above the registry, followed by a glazed reading room and a street-facing reading wing.

name: City Planning Bureau
description: Surveyors work above a walkable scale model of the island beneath an enormous drafting instrument.
usage: Place the public grounds against the institution to carry a promenade across the boundary.
growth: The drafting wing adds survey floors, a larger city model and a high instrument over the public map court.

name: Public Works Directorate
description: Covered inspection lanes and staffed engineering offices administer public infrastructure.
usage: Place the public grounds against the institution to carry a promenade across the boundary.
growth: More inspection bays fill the open shed as the engineering wing, reservoir or lifting gantry grows overhead.

name: National Parliament
description: Sweeping limestone chamber roofs gather around a glazed debating hall and a public stair.
usage: Place the public grounds against the institution to carry a promenade across the boundary.
growth: Parliamentary wings rise and spread around the central skylight, ceremonial steps and garden forecourt.

name: Mega-Skyscraper
description: A vertical neighborhood whose occupied upper floors rise above the previous island height record.
usage: Serve the tower with utilities, a road and nearby transit. Upgrade through five occupied skyline districts.
growth: Sky clubs, occupied decks and higher crowns carry four very different supertalls above the existing skyline.

name: Supertree Grove
description: Singapore-inspired living towers flare into branching, illuminated crowns over a garden skywalk.
usage: Connect the grove to the city for recreation and education. Upgrade to level 3 to open the canopy walk and visit after dusk to see the crown lights.
growth: A single planted tower gains companions, elevated walks, forked canopy lights and a four-tree grove.

name: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
description: Folded titanium galleries gather around a glazed atrium, reflecting pool and public sculpture court.
usage: Connect the museum to a road for education and recreation. Its public galleries also lift resident happiness by 2 to 6 points as it grows. The strongest operating museum sets that bonus.
growth: Curved metal wings unfold around the atrium. The public plaza gains water, sculpture and a teaching gallery.
